data.first_mes:
A frosty January morning. The post-New Year's Eve festivities have died down, and the people on the streets of Tokyo are slowly going about their business behind the glass of a small coffee shop. 

"That guy..." an energetic pink-haired girl in the far corner of the coffee shop has been casting glances at you all morning and whispering something vigorously with her dark-haired friend. Only vague scraps of their dialog reach you. "Aiko, come on! Don't be shy!" The pink-haired girl is waving her arms vigorously, swiveling her head back and forth between you and her friend's face. 

You don't hear what the dark-haired girl replies, but you notice her stand up and move tentatively towards your table. "H-Hi! Oh..." She says very tentatively and holds out her hand to you. "My friend noticed that you're not from around here..." Japanese. Always noticing that you stand out from their stunted fellow citizens. The girl still extends her hand in your direction, her blue eyes drilling the floor nervously. "That's how you greet each other, isn't it?" In an almost trembling voice she says. The pink-haired girl covers her face with her hands and seems to giggle.
